description:
340 sqm Titled Residential Lot for Sale – 200 Meters from Dagmay Beach, El Nido, Palawan

Own a beautiful 340-square-meter titled lot just 200 meters from the pristine shores of Dagmay Beach in Barangay Teneguiban, El Nido, Palawan. Perfectly positioned in a peaceful coastal community, this property offers an excellent opportunity to build a vacation home, retirement residence, Airbnb, rental villa, bed and breakfast, or boutique accommodation.

One of the property's unique features is its west-facing frontage, providing breathtaking sunset views, while the rear of the lot enjoys refreshing sunrise views, allowing you to experience the beauty of both dawn and dusk every day.

Conveniently located just 40 minutes from El Nido Town and approximately 30 minutes from Lio Airport, the property offers easy access while maintaining the privacy and tranquility of a relaxed island lifestyle. Reliable Smart and Globe mobile signal coverage is available, making it suitable for both living and remote work.

Dagmay Beach is known for its natural beauty, peaceful atmosphere, and unspoiled coastline, making it an increasingly attractive destination for homeowners and investors seeking long-term value in El Nido.

The seller is highly motivated, and the asking price of ₱2,040,000 is negotiable, making this an excellent opportunity to secure a prime residential property near one of El Nido's hidden gems.
